summary: Implementation plan for the Lightweight Texture & GPU Texture Filter Tuner feature, including real-time Before/After split-screen texture preview, Quick Presets (Smooth, Retro, Total Blocky, Custom), 5-step Texture Detail (Mipmap LOD Bias) slider, Sharp Pixels (GL_NEAREST) and Hard Distance Cutoff (Mipmap Snap) toggles, per-game and global targeting, and a real Device & GPU Compatibility Scanner.
